request: Why is order ORD-1010 late, and what should we do about it?

steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its promised delivery date, fulfillment status, and warehouse so I can determine if it is overdue and whether to check shipments or inventory next.
I will check the shipment tracking to see current status, delay reasons, and whether it is overdue against the promised date.
I will check carrier service alerts for Great Lakes Freight in Toledo, OH to see if a disruption explains the stalled tracking at that hub.

alerts.description: Winter storm closed the Toledo hub; backlog of held freight being cleared through 2026-03-13

steps.text: I will compile the findings and recommended actions based on the shipment being overdue and the matching carrier disruption at the Toledo hub.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1010 shipped on time but is 5 days past the 2026-03-11 promise; tracking shows it has been held at Great Lakes Freight’s Toledo, OH hub since 2026-03-07, which aligns with a carrier hub closure due to a winter storm. We should obtain a trace/updated ETA from the carrier and proactively inform the customer of the weather-related delay.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1010 fulfillment_status SHIPPED from WH-CHI; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-11; is_past_promised_date true (days_until_promised_date -5).

get_shipment_status: SHP-5010 via Great Lakes Freight tracking GLF-88307 status IN_TRANSIT; dispatch_date 2026-03-05; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-11; is_overdue true with days_past_promised_date 5; last_event_date 2026-03-07 at Toledo, OH; days_since_last_event 9; recorded_delay_reason null; dispatched_late false.
get_carrier_alerts: ALR-701 Great Lakes Freight Toledo, OH HUB_CLOSURE start 2026-03-06 end 2026-03-13 (winter storm; backlog clearing).
arguments.likely_cause: Great Lakes Freight’s Toledo, OH hub closure (winter storm 2026-03-06 to 2026-03-13) matching the shipment’s hold location and dates.
uncertainties: No current estimated delivery date is provided by the carrier; actual release timing from the Toledo hub and final delivery date remain unknown until the carrier responds.

recommended_actions.details: Request a trace and confirmed ETA from Great Lakes Freight for shipment SHP-5010 (tracking GLF-88307) held at Toledo, OH since 2026-03-07; the order is 5 days past the 2026-03-11 promise and tracking has been idle for 9 days (get_shipment_status).

Inform Fourth Coffee that delivery is delayed due to a Great Lakes Freight hub closure in Toledo, OH from 2026-03-06 to 2026-03-13 (get_carrier_alerts) and that the shipment has had no movement since 2026-03-07 (get_shipment_status); advise that we are seeking a confirmed ETA from the carrier.

arguments.recommendation: Contact Great Lakes Freight for a trace/updated ETA and notify the customer of the weather-related hub closure causing the delay.
